gbifID.description: Unique global occurrence record identifier assigned by GBIF.

datasetKey.description: Uniform dataset identifier expressed as a UUID string.

occurrenceID.description: Unique iNaturalist observation URL linking to each recorded Idea leuconoe sighting.

kingdom.description: Biological kingdom classification, always Animalia for these records.

phylum.description: Phylum classification for all records, consistently Arthropoda.

class.description: Organism belongs to the class Insecta.

order.description: Taxonomic order of the species, always Lepidoptera.

family.description: Taxonomic family of the butterfly, consistently Nymphalidae.

genus.description: Genus of the recorded butterfly, consistently “Idea” across all entries.

species.description: Scientific name of the recorded butterfly species, consistently Idea leuconoe.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Subspecies name of the recorded organism, most entries are “clara”.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of each record, either species or subspecies.

scientificName.description: Taxonomic designation of the observed Idea leuconoe specimens, including author and year.

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific names of recorded Idea leuconoe taxa, including subspecies and forms.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Original scientific name authorship field, currently empty for all records.

countryCode.description: Two-letter ISO codes identifying the country where each occurrence was recorded.

locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

stateProvince.description: Geographic region or administrative division where each occurrence was recorded.

occurrenceStatus.description: All entries confirm species presence at each recorded site.

individualCount.description: Individual count data is unavailable for all records.

publishingOrgKey.description: Publishing organization identifier linking all records to a single data provider.

decimalLatitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees for each occurrence record.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude in decimal degrees for each occurrence record.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Spatial uncertainty of occurrence coordinates measured in meters.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision data is unavailable for all records.

elevation.description: Elevation of observation site measured in meters above sea level.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy is unspecified for all records.

depth.description: Depth measurement is unavailable for all records.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth accuracy information is unavailable for all records.

eventDate.description: Observation date and time of each record.

day.description: Day of month for observation date.

month.description: Month of observation as integer values 1–12.

taxonKey.description: Taxonomic identifier linking each record to a specific Idea leuconoe classification.

speciesKey.description: Unique taxonomic identifier for each record of Idea leuconoe.

basisOfRecord.description: Record source type, always human observation.

institutionCode.description: Data source identifier for all records, consistently set to iNaturalist.

catalogNumber.description: Unique specimen identifier assigned by the collection for each occurrence record.

recordNumber.description: No data recorded for this field.

identifiedBy.description: Names of individuals who recorded each Leuconoe occurrence.

dateIdentified.description: Date and time when the specimen was identified.

license.description: License type for occurrence record, using Creative Commons variants (CC BY‑NC‑4.0, CC BY‑4.0, CC0‑1.0).

rightsHolder.description: Names of individuals or entities holding usage rights for each record.

recordedBy.description: Observers who documented each occurrence record.

typeStatus.description: No status information recorded for any occurrence.

establishmentMeans.description: Information on native or introduced status is missing for all records.

lastInterpreted.description: Last interpretation date and time of the occurrence record.

mediaType.description: Media type associated with each occurrence record, describing the format of attached documentation.

issue.description: Issue codes flag processing problems like rounded coordinates, derived continents, and missing taxon IDs.

idea_leuconoe.description: Occurrence records of Idea leuconoe (2003‑2026) with taxonomy, location, date, observer, and media metadata.

description: Records of Leuconoe species occurrences from 2003 to 2026 for biodiversity monitoring.
